title: athroandra poggei
intro: Athroandra poggei, commonly known as the 'Kapur Kuning', is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Athroandra poggei include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating pain, fever, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Athroandra poggei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in developing new treatments for various diseases.
